blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 58 in June to 55 in September (−5.2%), and it took 13.4% of the city’s 298 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 29 in June to 30 in September (+3.4%), and it took 3.4% of the city’s 558 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Aldergrove for condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.a: Aldergrove is in the Township of Langley, whose eastern boundary is 276 Street at Abbotsford and whose southern boundary is the United States border.

faq.q: Which schools serve an Aldergrove address?
faq.a: SD35 catchment is address-based; for the sample address 26850 29 Avenue the SD35 School Locator returns Parkside Centennial Elementary, Betty Gilbert Middle and Aldergrove Community Secondary. Other addresses may fall in different catchments, so check the exact address in the locator.

faq.q: What bus service runs from Aldergrove?
faq.a: TransLink route 503 runs from 272 Street at Fraser Highway via Langley Centre to Surrey Central Station, and BC Transit route 21 connects Aldergrove with Abbotsford from the same 272 Street stop.

faq.q: Where is grocery shopping in Aldergrove?
faq.a: FreshCo at 27566 Fraser Highway, Aldergrove, is named with its address on a Township page listing Extra Garbage sticker sale locations.

faq.q: Is land around Aldergrove in the Agricultural Land Reserve?
faq.a: Much of the Township's land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and the Township directs owners to check a specific property's designation in GeoSource. Parcel-level status must be checked per property.
